_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Dark Descent#000.src: Hello there, chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.

The Dark Descent#001.src: I... there... too many... th-thousands, at... at least...

The Dark Descent#003.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace!

The Dark Descent#004.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! I'm afraid they have already joined me, down below.

The Dark Descent#005.src: Y-you... I thought they... oh, gods, no...

The Dark Descent#006.src: Hush, now. You and your family will make fine additions to my legion.

The Dark Descent#007.src: Wha... you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone!

The Dark Descent#008.src: How naive. Fear not. You will rise again, and then you will serve my purpose.

The Dark Descent#010.src: How easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master?

The Dark Descent#011.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think to enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?

The Dark Descent#012.src: So enter the mouth of my skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...

The Dark Descent#013.src: Looks like the only way to go is into the skull...

The Dark Descent#014.src: You were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.

The Dark Descent#015.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a success!

The Dark Descent#016.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!

The Dark Descent#017.src: How foolish. You might think you are strong, adventurer, but you have no idea what you are about to face...

The Dark Descent#018.src: Simply marvellous work, chap! You've made it this far, so no time to fill your boots. Be prepared, we are about to fight Charon's undead army.

The Dark Descent#019.src: We've lost a lot of good men on the way here, but I believe we can still throw a heavy punch.

The Dark Descent#020.src: You've earned a lot of respect from the boys this fight, better than all of us I'd say. For this fight, I'll let you direct the army.

The Dark Descent#021.src: Don't take it as a promotion though, old bean. It's only for this fight, although you'll be getting a medal of valor if I can wangle it! Charon's army is remarkably strong, we need as much help as we can get.

The Dark Descent#022.src: Aey- careful now, {u}, the cretin must be lurking around here somewhere.

The Dark Descent#023.src: I see you've brought aid, you aren't as foolish as I thought.

The Dark Descent#024.src: Tell me, how do you plan to defeat an army that cannot die!?

The Dark Descent#026.src: Aha, chap! Wonderful, the {p} regiment's gotten its representative down 'ere. All rested up, I suppose, so let me give you an earful.

The Dark Descent#027.src: Those blighting zombies are all over the place. I tell ya, this skull's been giving the folk in {p} the collywobbles. Just as I thought, they're all coming from here.

The Dark Descent#028.src: Now, I don't wish to alarm you old bean, but I believe we are in front of the literal gates to hell.

The Dark Descent#029.src: Not to worry chuck! Don't look so glum, I've called for aid from the nearby towns. Once they get here we'll give them a good kicking, and you've already gotten out of there before, ain't ya?

The Dark Descent#030.src: Now is finally our chance to take down his army... It will be a jolly difficult battle, knowing our opponent and what he's managed, even away from his lair.

The Dark Descent#031.src: Still, early days to say what he could be like in person! I'll take another route, but we'll meet in front of his door, right after crossing the river. Good luck, old bean!

The Dark Descent#033.src: I have an entire undead army at my service. Do you really think you stand a chance?
The Dark Descent#033.dst: 我が配下にはアンデッドの軍勢がいる。本当に勝ち目があると思っているのか？

The Dark Descent#034.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Graken 将軍と話す

The Dark Descent#035.src: Ah, hello there chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#035.dst: やあ、君！まさか {p} の古巣の連隊の者にこんな所で会えるとはな。
The Dark Descent#035.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#036.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#036.dst: 私は Graken 将軍、{p} 民兵団の長だ。お会いできて光栄だ！
The Dark Descent#036.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#037.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#037.dst: そこら中をうろつくゾンビどもを見ただろう？どうもあの巨大な髑髏から湧いてくるらしい。
The Dark Descent#037.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#038.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#038.dst: 中を探る精鋭部隊を編成中だが、下に何があるのか皆目見当がつかんのだ！
The Dark Descent#038.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#039.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#039.dst: もし乗り気なら、旧市街を偵察して手がかりを探してくれると大いに助かる。
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#040.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#040.dst: さっき覗いてみたら、古い家の一軒が気になってな。扉の上にどでかい髑髏があったんだ！
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#041.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#041.dst: じっくり見る暇はなかったが、調べるならまずそこからだな。
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#042.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#042.dst: ここのすぐ南だ。古い家だが板張りはまだ頑丈だ。気を引き締めていけよ！
The Dark Descent#042.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#044.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#044.dst: しまった、何か忘れていると思ったんだ！踏ん張れ、君！今行くぞ！
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#045.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#045.dst: くそっ！遅かったか。そう、床が傷んでいると言い忘れていた。上だ！派手に落ちたな、大丈夫か？
The Dark Descent#045.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#046.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#046.dst: まあ、良い知らせもあるにはある。とはいえ、とんだ窮地に送り込んでしまったな！下に出口は見えるか？
The Dark Descent#046.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#047.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#047.dst: トンネルがある？ははっ、上出来だ！すぐにそこを進みたまえ。私は急ぎ持ち場に戻らねばならん！
The Dark Descent#047.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#048.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#048.dst: 幸運を祈るぞ、君！さあ下がれ、この悪党ども！下がれと言っている！
The Dark Descent#048.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#049.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
The Dark Descent#049.dst: ケヘヘ…もっと奥へおいで、小さな人間…影の中へ…

The Dark Descent#050.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
The Dark Descent#050.dst: 家の地下室にあるトンネルを探索する。

The Dark Descent#051.dst: 奇妙な闇の領域を調べる。

The Dark Descent#053.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#053.dst: 斥候！直ちに報告しろ！腐敗した者はどれだけ来ている？
The Dark Descent#053.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#054.dst: あっちに…多すぎる…す、数千は…少なくとも…
The Dark Descent#054.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#055.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#055.dst: 数千…？思ったよりずっとひどい。総員！迎撃準備――
The Dark Descent#055.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#056.dst: 無駄だ…俺たちは…もう終わりだ…
The Dark Descent#056.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#057.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#057.dst: 待て、な、何だ？お前、どうしたんだ？！
The Dark Descent#057.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#058.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#058.dst: お願い、やめて！誰だか知らないけど、私と家族を放っておいて！私たちが何をしたっていうの？！
The Dark Descent#058.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#059.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
The Dark Descent#059.dst: ああ、もっと早く言ってくれれば！彼らはもうこの世を去ったよ…いや、実に残念だ。

The Dark Descent#060.dst: あ、あなた…家族は…ああ、そんな…
The Dark Descent#060.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#061.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
The Dark Descent#061.dst: 静かに。お前と家族は必ず再会させてやろう。私の見守る下で…ケヘヘ…家族でお出かけもできるぞ…

The Dark Descent#062.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#062.dst: な…それって… い、いや、お願い！誰も傷つけたくない！死にたくない！！
The Dark Descent#062.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#063.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
The Dark Descent#063.dst: はは、世間知らずの娘だ。選べると思っているとは可愛いものだ。お前の望みなど、私には関係ない。

The Dark Descent#064.dst: ヘヘ…これで分かったか？

The Dark Descent#065.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
The Dark Descent#065.dst: この地がいかに容易く落ちたか分かるか？私がいかに早く支配者となったか？そしてお前など造作もなく始末できることが？

The Dark Descent#066.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
The Dark Descent#066.dst: 数百人が一瞬で虐殺され…無尽蔵の我が兵として蘇ったのだ。

The Dark Descent#067.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think you can enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#067.dst: 地上ですら辛うじて食い止めているのに、私の領域に踏み込み、冥界で私に挑めると思っているのか？

The Dark Descent#068.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
The Dark Descent#068.dst: お前は敗れ、私はその体を操り人形のように吊るし、私のために踊らせてやろう。

The Dark Descent#069.src: So enter the mouth of the skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#069.dst: ならば髑髏の口に入れ、兵士よ。地の底へ進むがいい。次に会うのを楽しみにしているぞ、ケヘヘヘ…

The Dark Descent#070.dst: 奇妙な闇の領域から出る。

The Dark Descent#071.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Dark Descent#071.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Graken にルビーを返す

The Dark Descent#072.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
The Dark Descent#072.dst: さあ、自分の世界へ帰るがいい。それでもまだ私に挑むなら…待っているぞ。

The Dark Descent#073.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#073.dst: おい！こっちだ、こっちへ来い！ゾンビどもとうろうろするのはやめたまえ！
The Dark Descent#073.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#074.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#074.dst: おーい！聞こえるか？！君？なぜ虚ろな目でさまよっている？戻ってこい！
The Dark Descent#074.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#075.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#075.dst: しっかりしろ、ほら！目に少し生気を――よし、それでいい！戻ったか、君？
The Dark Descent#075.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#076.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#076.dst: 素晴らしい！一時はひどく心配したぞ。で、下で何があったのか聞かせてくれるか？
The Dark Descent#076.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#077.src: But, you were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#077.dst: だが君はボケた老婆のようによろめいて、目は真っ白、Charon がどうとかずっと呟いていたぞ。
The Dark Descent#077.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#078.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a jolly good success!
The Dark Descent#078.dst: 君を連れ回したのはそいつか？まあ、死んではいないのだから、この作戦は大成功と言っていいだろう！
The Dark Descent#078.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#079.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#079.dst: 君の発見は我々の情報とぴたりと合う――確信したよ。この忌々しいゾンビどもを止めるには、地下へ行くしかない。
The Dark Descent#079.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#080.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#080.dst: 先遣隊が脳みそなど実に不快な物を持ち帰ったが――なかなか見事な宝飾品もあったぞ！
The Dark Descent#080.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#081.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#081.dst: いくつか持っていけ。我々の敵を忘れぬようにな。だが目的は見失うなよ！
The Dark Descent#081.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#082.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along again in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#082.dst: 準備ができたら、また地の底への遠征に加わってもらえると嬉しいぞ、友よ！
The Dark Descent#082.speaker: General Graken
